home_welcome: Night radio · Make yourself at home
home_make_time: Make a little time for music
home_queue_ready: Your queue is ready. Pick up the melody.
home_choose_music: Start with a familiar playlist or something newly added.
home_more_playlists: Find the rest of your playlists in the sidebar.
home_load_failed: Couldn't load your library. Please try again.
home_empty_library: No music yet. Import a few favorites to get started.
choose_audio: Choose a local audio file to start listening
drop_tracks: Drop in a few local tracks
lyrics_choose_song: Choose a Kugou song version, then its lyrics.
lyrics_cache_warning: Lyrics loaded, but could not save the cache.
lyrics_error_timeout: Lyrics search failed. Please try again.
lyrics_error_network: Lyrics request failed. Check your connection.
lyrics_error_rate_limited: Lyrics service rate limit reached. Try later.
lyrics_error_local_read: Cannot read the local lyrics file.
lyrics_error_invalid_local: The local LRC contains no valid lyrics.
delete_playlist_hint: Only this playlist and its song memberships will be removed. The queue, other playlists and music files are kept.
empty_playlist: This playlist is quiet right now
no_playlists: No playlists yet. Create a playlist first.
delete_tag_hint: Removes this tag from every song. Songs and music files are kept.
delete_selected_hint: Deletes these songs from the library, playlists, and queue. Managed file cleanup is selected by default; uncheck it to keep the files.
clean_managed_files: Also clean files managed by NekoTune
clean_managed_files_hint: Permanently delete managed audio or symlinks and matching lyrics and artwork. External originals and other files are kept. This cannot be undone.
cleanup_partial_warning: Tracks were removed, but these staged files could not be cleaned. Delete them manually:
empty_library: No songs yet. Import music to begin.
no_tag_matches: No songs have all selected tags
kugou_key_status_saved: Kugou key is saved in the system keyring.
kugou_key_status_external: Using a Kugou key from the launch environment.
kugou_keyring_error: Keyring access or credential migration failed. Unlock the keyring and restart; legacy files are removed after successful migration.
kugou_key_help: Enter the same key as the Kugou Worker's ACCOUNT_API_KEY. It is stored in the system keyring and never shown again here. Clearing it restores the launch environment key, if present.
kugou_key_saved: Key saved. You can sign in from Kugou Music.
kugou_logged_in: Kugou is signed in. You can download songs.
kugou_login_prompt: Sign in with your mobile number and SMS code.
kugou_key_missing: Downloads need a key. Enter it on the Settings page.
kugou_download_success: Audio downloaded and added to the library.
kugou_lyric_error: Lyrics failed; audio is still available.
kugou_cover_error: Cover failed; audio is still available.
clear_queue_hint: Clear the queue and stop playback. Your library, playlists and local files are kept.
anonymous_search_hint: Search freely. Sign in to download songs to your library.
ai_settings_help: Connect an OpenAI-compatible text model to organize titles, artists and tags. Only filenames, existing information and lyrics are sent when requested. Review before saving.
ai_model_placeholder: Enter the model ID supplied by your service
ai_key_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
ai_key_saved: This service's key is saved in the system keyring.
ai_key_optional: No key saved for this service. Keyless endpoints are supported.
ai_key_new_endpoint: Changing the service address will not reuse the previous service's key. Enter a new key if needed.
ai_save_before_test: Save your settings before testing. Testing makes one model request.
ai_key_cleared: The key for this service has been cleared.
ai_test_passed: Connected. The model returned the expected format.
ai_fill_help: Uses the filename, existing information and lyrics. Keeps existing tags. Review before saving.
ai_filled: AI suggestions applied. Edit as needed, then save to keep them.
ai_partial_result: Some names lacked reliable evidence and were left unchanged. Review before saving.
ai_error_configuration: Set your AI service address and model in Settings first.
ai_error_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS API address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
ai_error_model: Enter a valid model name (up to 256 characters).
ai_error_key: Invalid key format. Check for newlines or extra characters.
ai_error_keyring: The system keyring is unavailable or locked. Unlock it and retry.
ai_error_key_missing: The saved AI key is missing. Save it again or clear the key.
ai_error_settings: Unable to save AI settings. Check the configuration directory.
ai_error_response: The model returned invalid or truncated data. Retry or choose another model.
ai_error_refused: The model could not process this information. Your content was kept.
ai_error_timeout: The AI request exceeded 60 seconds. Please retry.
ai_error_cancelled: The AI request ended. Please retry.
ai_error_auth: AI authentication failed. Check the key and its permissions.
ai_error_rate_limit: The AI service is rate limited or out of credits. Please retry later.
ai_error_service: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.
ai_error_request: The AI service rejected the request. Check the URL, model and API compatibility.
ai_error_network: Unable to connect to the AI service. Check the network and service address.
ai_error_busy: Several AI requests are still running. Please retry shortly.
kugou_worker_help: Off by default. Enter your Worker root URL, enable Kugou and save to use music search, downloads and lyrics search. Remote URLs must use HTTPS; omit the API path.
lyrics_error_kugou_unavailable: Enable Kugou music and set the Worker URL in Settings. Search again after changing the URL.
extension_description: Add features, music sources and interfaces. Press Ctrl+Shift+E to open the manager.
extension_empty: No extensions installed. Import a ZIP package or mount a development folder.
extension_trust_body: Extensions run with the same user privileges as NekoTune. They can access files, networks and programs, and replace the interface. Continue only if you trust this code. Enabling grants full access.
extension_clear_data: Also delete extension configuration and data (kept by default)
music_sources_empty: Enable a music source extension to search and play.
